promptLatex: A straight angle of $180^{\circ}$ is split by a ray into two angles measuring $x$ and $2x$ degrees. What is $x$?
hintLatex: The two pieces have to add up to the whole straight angle.
Write that as an equation in $x$.
solutionLatex:
The ray splits the straight angle into pieces of $x$ and $2x$ degrees.

The pieces together make the whole $180^{\circ}$, so $x + 2x = 180$.

That gives $3x = 180$, so $x = 60$.
